description: Depuradoras is a dataset listed in Diputació de Castelló open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. Estaciones depuradoras ubicadas en la provincia de Castellón, con indicación de la titularidad, fórmula de gestión, tratamiento y capacidad. Las diferentes estaciones depuradoras están geolocalizadas. El dataset incorpora un archivo adjunto sobre el manual de instrucciones que nos ayuda a entender la nomenclatura que aparece en las columnas. Coverage: Province of Castellón. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are calidad ambiental, municipios, residuos, geolocalizado, provincia de Castellón. The portal shows 134 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-01-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datosabiertos-dipcas-es-portal.
